Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: pivotal primary-class icons for a post-apocalyptic tabletop interface. Create ONE LANDSCAPE image containing exactly TWO independent glyphs, LEFT option A and RIGHT option B, in two equal side-by-side cells. No visible grid, captions, labels, letters, numbers, logos or border. Both options must use PURE SOLID WHITE #FFFFFF on perfectly clean PURE BLACK #000000. Match the reference's sober broad stencil weight, with large black negative-space cuts. Each complete glyph occupies the middle 60 percent of its own cell, with generous blank space on ALL sides and a wide empty black gutter between the two options. No part crosses the middle division. Each option contains exactly TWO distinct main elements, covering different sides of the class. They are two alternative emblems for the SAME class, not two halves of one combined emblem. Readability at 16/24/32 pixels matters: broad silhouettes, very few internal cuts, complete coherent objects. No shading, grey, gradients, hatching, dithering, texture, distressing, hair strands, tiny fittings or thin detail. No anime, cartoon anatomy, gruff survivor busts, giant generic cogs, decorative frames or gore. The first reference is STYLE ONLY; do not copy its subject or nine-cell layout.
CLASS: Brutal. Role: Berserk and Strength-based melee define the class; Bare Chest rewards fighting without armor. Starting equipment includes a heavy hammer and tactical knife. Represent physical force and melee equipment rather than unrelated freedom symbolism.
LEFT OPTION A: ONE powerful complete BARE CLENCHED FIST beside ONE heavy industrial SLEDGEHAMMER angled upward-right behind it. Coherent thumb and four folded fingers, short bare wrist; hammer has one broad rectangular steel head and one stout complete handle. Clear broad black separation keeps fist and hammer separately readable. Unarmed force plus heavy melee; no chain, armor, face, tiny knuckles or debris.
RIGHT OPTION B: ONE plain HEADLESS BARE ADULT UPPER TORSO beside ONE complete practical TACTICAL KNIFE pointing upward. Torso ends at base of neck and above waist; ordinary strong adult proportions, shoulders and chest as one broad modest solid mass with only TWO large anatomical cuts. Knife has one broad blade, short guard and stout handle; black separation from torso. Unarmored toughness plus melee precision. No nipples, bodybuilder detail, person portrait, extra limbs, fine serrations, injuries or gore.
